arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# More edge cases
edge_cases = [
    # Valid cases
    ('{}', 'hello'),                    # anonymous field
    ('{0}', 'hello'),                   # numeric name (allowed by regex)
    ('{a.b.c}', 'hello'),               # dotted with multiple levels
    ('{d[k1][k2]}', 'hello'),           # nested dict access
    ('{:d}', '123'),                    # typed field
    ('{{}}', '{{}}'),                   # both escaped braces in a row
    ('{{{name}}}', 'test'),             # escaped braces around field
    
    # Invalid cases
    ('{', None),                        # just open brace
    ('}', None),                        # just close brace
    ('{{abc', None),                    # escaped open + unclosed
    ('abc{{def', None),                 # text + escaped open + more text (should work actually)
]

print('=== Edge case tests ===')
for fmt, val in edge_cases:
    try:
        parser = parse.Parser(fmt)
        if val is not None:
            result = parser.parse(val)
            print(f'  {fmt!r}: OK -> {result}')
        else:
            print(f'  {fmt!r}: Parser created OK (expression: {parser._expression!r})')
    except ValueError as e:
        print(f'  {fmt!r}: ValueError (expected for invalid): {e}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'  {fmt!r}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')
" 2>&1
